static_review_findings.detail: The provider patches importlib.util.module_from_spec only for the exact v092_scoped_recovery_packet name, matching execute-release-v092.py::_scoped_recovery_module, and validates the nested LEDGER_PATH and _regular_bytes/validate_packet API.

The nested reader receives only canonical bytes whose SHA and 88-row count match the sealed historical prefix. The outer provider separately requires an exact canonical 89-row input beginning with those 88 rows and matching the live ledger head.
recover_bifrost_history delegates the caller's exact 89-row bytes unchanged to the pinned predecessor, preserving its full frozen terminal checker/replay and receipt validation.

_prefix_bytes reads only the supplied 89-row head and does not require live-file equality; a later 109-row live ledger remains admissible while the recovery input stays exactly 89 rows. No extra tail is handed to the historical nested reader.
The nested module _regular_bytes wrapper restores in finally, and the importlib module_from_spec hook restores in the outer finally, including validation exceptions.
The frozen scripts/v092_scoped_recovery.py source and 64 MiB default are untouched; non-target paths and descriptions delegate to the original reader.
Provider has no CLI, subprocess, analyzer, admission, replay, evidence-write, or ledger-write path; its sole integration entry point returns validated in-process history.
